pages.text: Restore cores from tunnel corpses or Forgotten Tunnel Slimes through $(l:world/mine_recovery)mine recovery$(). It starts in Wait and cannot be crafted. Its summon item shows a purple-edged core on a gold plate. The slime wears a helmet, cart and white crest.

Work and movement use half the normal stamina. An effective tool mines tagged ancient Slimic stone and masonry 50% faster, including stone, cobblestone, stone bricks, chiseled bricks, and ancient foundations. Incorrect tools and insufficient tiers never receive the bonus.

Use the normal $(l:companions/tunnel)Tunnel Slime$() direction and nonconsumable lining template. Lining consumes actual bag materials, protects existing quarry stairs, and stops when supplies run out. Carriers supply it normally. Clear old webs and corpses first; this worker cannot pass through solid rubble.
